maddeler.e:
أستهدم (form X)
# أَسْتَهْدِمُ (ʔastahdimu) /ʔas.tah.di.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# أَسْتَهْدِمَ (ʔastahdima) /ʔas.tah.di.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# أَسْتَهْدِمْ (ʔastahdim) /ʔas.tah.dim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
